description: Voie Vélo Régionale is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de La Réunion, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Réunion DRR - DEER - SRS. La Région Réunion, dans le cadre de la recherche d’une alternative au tout-automobile, aménage sa Voie Vélo Régionale (VVR). Coverage: La Réunion. The portal files it under Transports et déplacements. Its keywords are velo, cycle, VVR. The portal shows 409 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-regionreunion-com-portal.
